description:
Found 2026-08-13 while working op-tvmf.

kovan_literature::pdf_import::extract_assets(pdf, out_dir) exists at crates/kovan-literature/src/pdf_import.rs:70 and is tested (:178). The kovan-cli 'lit import' subcommand exposes ONLY --json-out and --markdown-out, so there is no way to invoke it from the CLI. Result: crates/kovan-literature/generated/assets/ is empty and every imported KovanDocument records assets: [].

WHY IT MATTERS NOW: Terry et al. (2005) INL/CON-05-00852 carries the HTR-10 R-Z zone geometry in its Figure 2 (the simplified axisymmetric model, section 2), NOT in its text. The PDF stores it as raster (5 /Subtype /Image, all FlateDecode, no vector operators), so it must be digitised with kovan-digitise -- and digitising requires the figure as an image file, which the CLI cannot produce. This blocks the remaining work on op-tvmf.

FIX: add an --assets-out <DIR> flag to 'kovan lit import' that calls extract_assets and records the returned paths in the KovanDocument's assets field. Default off, so existing behaviour is unchanged.

CAUTION: assets extracted from a PROPRIETARY source are themselves proprietary. They must land under crates/kovan-literature/generated/assets/proprietary/, which is gitignored (verified 2026-08-13, along with a newly-added generated/**/proprietary/ catch-all). Do not let a default output path write extracted figures somewhere committable.
title: kovan lit import cannot emit figure assets — library can, CLI cannot

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
2026-08-21: the outstanding item from this bead's 2026-07-20 comment --
"Remaining: per-(alpha,beta) S-matrix / endout MF=7 comparison" -- is now
DONE, for Si-in-SiC.

Commit 1a904fc5, tests/leapr_temperature_block_selection.rs::
si_in_sic_kernel_reproduces_the_published_evaluation_at_every_temperature.
Regenerating S(alpha,beta) from the embedded tsl-SiinSiC.leapr deck and
comparing point-by-point against reference-data/endf/tsl-SiinSiC.endf
(ENDF/B-VIII.0 MAT 43, the evaluation this deck produced):

  306,033 tabulated points across all 8 declared temperatures
  (300/400/500/600/700/800/1000/1200 K), worst deviation 0.0000% --
  agreement to the 6 significant digits ENDF stores. T_eff matches exactly at
  every temperature (421.3892 K at 300 K through 1234.096 K at 1200 K).

This is a published-evaluation oracle for a two-sublattice compound, which is
stronger than the self-consistency checks the module carried before, and it
exercises the full contin -> phonon_expansion -> endout path plus the dwpix/
tempf conversions.

Caveat on scope: this validates the MT=4 INELASTIC writer. The MT=2 elastic
side for the same material is still ~3% off (op-4daf). And the comparison was
done for one material -- H-in-H2O now also reproduces its published T_eff and
four published sigma_inel points to <=0.01% (see the same commit), but that is
a scalar/cross-section comparison, not a full S-matrix diff.

The bead's other listed gaps (copys, skold, run() driver, MF=1/451 Hollerith,
mixed-moderator merge nss!=0) are unchanged -- still tracked in op-b2k.

Related and found by this work: op-ergh (the regeneration cache does not key on
the generator, so a physics fix keeps serving stale tapes).

title: LEAPR: MF=7 tape writer (endout/copys) + coldh orchestrator + coherent-elastic

description:
docs/reactor-scoping/vtb-findings.md section 3 states that HTR-10 is 'a complete, self-contained neutronics benchmark: library, mesh and gold solution, all retrievable and parseable' and reports two eigenvalues: initial critical 1.0009032234669475 and full core all-rods-out 1.1234734552111967. Verified 2026-08-11 against the actual checkout, that overstates what is present.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY IN reference-data/virtual_test_bed/htgr/htr10/: exactly four files, all under steady/ - htr-10-critical.i, htr-10-full.i, tests, custom_cmp_no_connected_region_id. There is no data/ directory and no gold/ directory.

ABSENT, NOT git-LFS POINTERS (the repository has no .gitattributes at all):
- ../data/mesh/htr-10-critical-a-rev6.e and ../data/mesh/htr-10-full-a-rev3.e
- ../data/xs/htr-10-XS.xml (the ten-group library)
- ../data/sph/htr-10-Diff-SPH.xml
- both gold Exodus files
Other VTB models (msr, sfr, pbfhr, httr, htr-pm, s8er) DO ship real mesh and XS artefacts, so the omission is specific to HTR-10.

THE ONE RECOVERABLE EIGENVALUE is k = 1.1234735, in a comment at custom_cmp_no_connected_region_id:32, for the FULL CORE all-rods-out SPH-corrected 10-group diffusion case (library_name = htr-10-full-ARO). The same exodiff spec is reused for the critical-configuration test (tests:21), so NO gold for the critical configuration is recoverable from these files. Where the 1.0009032234669475 figure in vtb-findings.md came from should be re-checked.

TWO CAVEATS TO ADD WHEN CORRECTING: the VTB authors' own '# Incomplete XS library' comment at tests:22 and tests:35; and - contradicting vtb-findings.md's general warning - there is NO CI truncation here (num_steps, fixed_point_max_its and max_its appear nowhere in tests or either .i file; only wall-clock guards max_time = 500 and 400).

WHAT VTB IS STILL GOOD FOR: a modelling reference. Block structure, G = 10 (htr-10-full.i:196), the states the library carries (htr-10-full-1RI / -393K / -523K / -ARI / -ARO, htr-10-full.i:39-40), and the outer geometry bounds. It is not a runnable benchmark here.

Related: docs/reactor-scoping/htr10-neutronics.md section 3.4 already records this correctly.
title: docs: correct vtb-findings.md - the VTB HTR-10 case is not a self-contained benchmark in this checkout

description: Map a disk-topology open mesh to 2D via Tutte/harmonic embedding: order the boundary loop, fix it to a convex shape (circle by arc length), solve the boundary-pinned Laplacian for interior (u,v) reusing the laplacian_smooth reduced-system solve. Uniform weighting = Tutte (bijective, no flips); cotangent = harmonic. Reuses the sparse-solve foundation.
title: outram-blender: harmonic/Tutte planar parameterization

description: ~40 sites panic on out-of-range input. Every reactor model touching steam inherits the hazard, and any transient that overshoots kills the physics thread outright. Already identified in docs/reactor-scoping/ipwr.md:110-121. Prerequisite for the MSRE real-time demo and for any long unattended run. Add a Result-returning facade over the panicking internals rather than changing every internal signature at once.
title: tampines-steam-tables: bounds-checked IF97 facade returning Result

description: Part of op-72hy. RootConfig (crates/kovan/src/root.rs) needs a new config section naming the private literature submodule's mount path (literature/proprietary/ per the comment's layout sketch) and its git remote, so KOVAN knows where to find/init it. Hard requirement from the comment: credentials or tokens must NEVER be stored in kovan_root.toml -- auth stays Git/SSH/credential-manager's responsibility entirely; this config is a path + a remote URL only, nothing secret. Must be optional/absent by default (existing libraries with no private submodule configured are unaffected). Depends conceptually on op-dlv8's storage-mode concept existing first.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented: PrivateSubmoduleConfig{remote} added to crates/kovan/src/root.rs, RootConfig.private_submodule: Option<PrivateSubmoduleConfig> (absent by default), RootConfig::with_private_submodule() builder. Deliberately reuses paths.restricted_sources as the mount path rather than adding a second path field -- one directory, one convention, whether or not it happens to be a submodule this session (matches the GH comment's own sketch showing the submodule AT literature/proprietary/, today's existing restricted_sources default). remote is a bare git URL, never a credential -- structurally there is no field to put one in. gitignore_for() now takes Option<&PrivateSubmoduleConfig> and omits the restricted-source pattern entirely when a submodule is configured (both the fresh-gitignore path and the merge-into-existing-gitignore path in KovanRoot::create); KovanRoot gained private_submodule()/private_submodule_ready() (the latter checking BOTH configured AND an actual .git checkout present, since configuration alone doesn't mean initialised -- feeds op-t1ex). 9 new tests. Verified: cargo check -p kovan --all-targets --all-features clean; cargo test -p kovan --lib --release: 365 passed, 0 failed.

title: kovan_root.toml: configure a private literature submodule
